title: Meet Brim: the bottle that stays cold

scenes.headline: Your water is warm by noon
scenes.narration: Be honest, your water is warm by lunchtime. Again. We built Brim to fix exactly that.

scenes.headline: Double-wall steel, vacuum sealed
scenes.narration: Brim is double-wall stainless steel with a vacuum seal, so ice stays frozen through a long afternoon.

scenes.headline: Built for real days
scenes.narration: It fits a cup holder. The lid opens one-handed. And it goes in the dishwasher without a fuss.

scenes.headline: Made to be carried
scenes.narration: Throw it in a gym bag, a backpack, or the car door. It is made for the way you actually move.
